Pension costs charged to the income statement consist of service cost (current
and past service cost gains and losses arising from curtailment and settlement) and
administration costs (other than costs of managing plan assets) which are allocated
to the appropriate heading by function and net interest expense or income which is
presented as part of net financial income/(expense). The actual return less interest
income on plan assets changes in actuarial assumptions and differences between
actuarial assumptions and what has actually occurred are reported in other comprehensive
income. Some benefits are also provided by defined contribution plans. Contributions
to such plans are charged to the income statement as incurred.

Certain disclosures are presented by geographic area. The five regions disclosed are
North America (NA) Europe (EUR) Asia Oceania and Africa including Middle East (AOA)
Latin America (LATAM) and Greater China (GC). Each region includes the corresponding
Zones as well as the portion of the GMB activity in that region.
